english: You detect something unusual about this section of wall.
Or your senses are playing tricks on you.
Oh yeah, that's just the passage to the crypt.
You know about all the secret doors down here?
Just this one. It's right by the Roots. It changes every other month or so, if we don't keep watch.
Gotta make sure it stays closed. Ever since you clerics stopped doing delves periodically, the undead issue has gotten a bit messy.
Yeah. We really have fucked up with that policy of non-delving.
We can't be responsible for every cranny and nook with scadoodling bones.
I get the reason behind it - gotta focus on the upstairs - but it's risky to leave defending the underbelly to third parties, I'd say.
Even if we're doing a fucking great job, all things considered.
Anyway, if you wanna check inside, you could probably hit that tile there.
Your gloved fingers trace the stone.
A tile. Distinct from the others.
The smell of old stone and dust.
Sweet. I'll keep my sling ready.
He means his weapon, not his manhood.
That won't be needed in this dead, bony place. Hopefully...
